name: @bts-soft/create-starter
author: Omar Ahmed Sabry
description: Production-ready NestJS 12 starter template: GraphQL (Apollo, code-first), TypeORM + PostgreSQL, Redis cache and sessions, JWT auth with refresh-token rotation and blacklisting, RBAC, Google OAuth 2.0, sliding-window rate limiting, i18n (en/ar), structured logging with trace IDs, Prometheus metrics, health probes, and isolated Docker Compose stacks for development, test, staging and production.
